UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd Gatekeeper; if echo '{{amp_url}}' | grep -q '^https://'; then HOST=$(echo '{{amp_url}}' | sed -E 's#^https://##; s#/.*##; s#:.*##'); PORT=$(echo '{{amp_url}}' | sed -E 's#^https://[^:/]+##; s#/.*##; s#^:##'); [ -z \"$PORT\" ] && PORT=443; CERTIFI_PEM=$(PYTHONPATH=pydeps /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import certifi; print(certifi.where())' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n \"$CERTIFI_PEM\" ]; then echo | openssl s_client -connect \"$HOST:$PORT\" -servername \"$HOST\" 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 >> \"$CERTIFI_PEM\" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi"

-c "cd Gatekeeper && cat > tokens.py <<'PYEOF'
token = '{{discord_token}}'
AMPAuth = '{{amp_2fa}}'
AMPUser = '{{amp_user}}'
AMPPassword = '{{amp_password}}'
AMPurl = '{{amp_url}}'
PYEOF
"
